_comment: 最终航行「还剩下什么」+ 三个去处 + 人物短尾声（剧情姐合订稿 in1030/yun1.txt 第 153–240 行）。入口 start_final。11-07 作者：通讯器/手机全删（泥芙消息、结局一发消息、各处拿出通讯器看聊天记录都没了；想朋友的话还在，闪回四的字也在）。燃料界面（todo_mechanic final_flight）选中一件纪念品时播 look_<id>，确认转化后播 burn_<id>（设 burned_<id>）。11-07 结局重构：一次 pick（final_nav，ui action）三个去处——西侧旧货场的芦苇地（真结局 ending1，燃料要 760：全收集、全炸、全烧，灰掉时写还差多少）、居民区=云层小镇（ending3，停在小镇，全剧终）、掉头回母星（ending_home，直接接列车 epi_home，全剧终）；结局二、四删了。燃料柜 final_paper 一次就能烧完（min 300 能收起，fuel_need 760）。设 final_ending_1 / final_ending_3 / final_ending_home；结局里的动作和尾声按 burned_* / final_seed_planted / 森林 returned_all、returned_any、saw_rock 分支。if / goto 是跳转（不返回）。带 added 的是补写。终章引擎（10-31）：结局一、二都在芦苇地 reed_field（yard_* 在西半边、east_* 在东半边，写的是房间 x，美术定了再挪）；尾声森林的 forest_* 是森林的世界 x（树屋那一段），treehouse_* / forest_treehouse 写成第一章 marker 的名字（别名）；rooms 里的 river_bank 只为泥芙家这间小屋有地方放（小屋的 host）。两次 pick 带 ui（cockpit_nav.gd：二次确认、导航屏三个点）。

final_route.spec: 接近云层星的航道比旧记录复杂。碎石带向外扩展，稳定气流只剩几条窄路，玩家需要综合运用声音辨向、避障和修补。正确操作能减少燃料损耗，此前多收集的材料也在这里发挥作用。操作与准备能省下一部分材料，剩余航程仍需要玩家从纪念品中作出取舍。

cab_think.zh: 大象我还是想找，消息也还是想等。

final_paper.spec: 【最终航行：将听声避障、简短修补和燃料选择结合。选择物品时飞机进入稳定航行状态，玩家可以阅读说明、最后播放声音或取消选择。确认转化后消耗所选物品，其余纪念品保留。列表仅显示当前持有的物品。】（剧本约定：可以做成 flight1 的 keepsake_choice 加多选 / 可退出；选中一件时播 look_<物品id>，确认转化后播 burn_<物品id>；蓝色石头 / 通勤卡剩下的那件用 burn_final_<id>。）
final_paper.spec_journal_rule: 【日记首页为始终保留的剧情物件，不计入可转化燃料。日记首页在所有物品选择及四个结局中均予保留，“我一定要找到大象，因为”后面始终空着，页面仅供查看。】

ending1._note: 11-02 作者：窗外开云、降落那几张很奇怪，「还是老样子加速飞走然后黑屏切换」——和飞行一结尾同一套往前一冲
11-08 作者：终章云层星配乐用萨蒂 Gymnopédie No.1（裸体圆舞曲）。冲出去以后飞船配乐还在响，黑屏里交叉过去，落地时这首已经起来；芦苇地、回驾驶舱、尾声回访（鹿 → 弥洛 → 泥芙 → 列车）、结局回看一路不停（11-08 作者「闪回的时候一直播放钢琴曲」：树屋不再切 forest、泥芙家不再停），全剧终卡交叉到 theme

yard_sign.zh: 指示牌：「饮水处，大型动物」，箭头往东。

yard_sign._note: 11-07 作者：独白打在屏幕上（原来是对话框）

e1_rubbing._note: 11-07 作者：独白打在屏幕上（原来是对话框）

e1_meet.en: I've been looking for you for a long time.

e1_meet.zh: 背包别放那么近，它爱翻有吃的味道的袋子。
e1_meet.en: Don't keep your bag so close. It likes digging through anything that smells like food.
Not this. It's the last of it.

options.en: So you're this loud when you eat.
Can I watch you a little longer?

options.zh: 我还以为，见到你以后会有很多话。
options.en: I thought I'd have so much to say when I met you.

options.zh: 你认识一只鹿吗？它管我叫孩子。
options.en: Do you know a deer? It calls me its kid.

e1_ch_a.zh: 它一直这样，隔着半条河都听得见。
e1_ch_a.en: Always is. You can hear it from across the river.

e1_ch_c.en: ...And now I can't think of a single thing.

e1_sit.zh: 我一直以为，找到它以后，我一定会高兴得不得了。
e1_sit.en: I always thought that once I found it, I'd be over the moon.

e1_sit.zh: 刚才确实挺高兴。现在腿有点麻，还有点饿。
e1_sit.en: And I was, just now. Now my legs are asleep, and I'm a bit hungry.

e1_sit.zh: 吃的话，往那边走，有个小摊。
e1_sit.en: If you want food, there's a stall that way.
I'm going to get something to eat. You carry on.

e1_sit._note: 11-08 作者：透明种子 / 弥洛的纸条从第一章删了，种种子这段跳过（e1_note / e1_seed_hint / e1_plant 留着不删）

e1_plant_ask.en: The damp soil by the water's fine.

e1_passerby_chat.en: It's not afraid of people. Doesn't care about them either.

e1_paper_get.zh: 日记烧了，跟路过的人借了张纸。
e1_paper_get.en: The journal's gone. Borrowed a sheet from the passerby.
e1_paper_get._note: 11-07 作者：独白打在屏幕上（原来是对话框）

e1_write.zh: 今天找到大象了：左耳有缺口，吃草很响，会翻袋子。
e1_write.en: Found the elephant today: notch in the left ear, loud when it eats grass, goes through bags.

narr.zh: 第一页上还是那句：「我一定要找到大象，因为」
narr.en: The first page still says: "I have to find the elephant, because"

11-08 作者：终章云层星配乐用萨蒂 Gymnopédie No.1（裸体圆舞曲）。冲出去以后飞船配乐还在响，黑屏里交叉过去，落地时这首已经起来；一直放过结局回看（11-08 作者「闪回的时候一直播放钢琴曲」：回看见到 gymnopedie1 就不切 forest），全剧终卡交叉到 theme

ending3.zh: 你在找大象？它今天一直在喷泉那边。
ending3.en: Looking for the elephant? It's been by the fountain all day.

ending3.zh: 走吧，飞机我们帮你固定。
ending3.en: Come on. We'll tie down your ship.

town_basket.en: It knocked that over just now.

options.zh: 我是它妈妈，叫一声它就过来了。
options.en: I'm its mom. It'll come if I call.

options.zh: 你们是不是在拿我开玩笑？
options.en: Are you all pulling my leg?

e3_ask.zh: 大家看到的，是这一头吗？
e3_ask.en: Is this the one you're all seeing?

e3_ask.zh: 是是是！刚才它还把鼻子伸进喷泉里！
e3_ask.en: Yes, yes! It just stuck its trunk in the fountain!

e3_ask.zh: 今天先回去歇着吧。明天再来。
e3_ask.en: Go get some rest today. Come back tomorrow.

e3_touch._note: 11-04 夜测：原来淡入在喷泉正中，站在池子里（穿模）
11-07 作者：独白打在屏幕上（原来是对话框）

e3_paper_get.zh: 日记烧了，跟住处的人借了几张纸。
e3_paper_get.en: The journal's gone. Borrowed a few sheets from the lodging.
e3_paper_get._note: 11-07 作者：独白打在屏幕上（原来是对话框）

e3_write1.zh: 今天，我终于见到了大象
e3_write1.en: Today I finally met the elephant
At least, that's what they all say

narr.zh: 门外有人喊：「今天它跟你可亲了！」
narr.en: Someone calls from outside the door: "It was so sweet on you today!"

e3_confess.zh: 昨天我伸手的时候，手心里是空的。
e3_confess.en: Yesterday, when I reached out, my hand touched nothing.
Huh? Then... are we still going?

e3_confess._note: 11-04 夜测：原来淡入在喷泉正中，站在池子里（穿模）

e3_listen.en: They say it's swinging its nose

e3_listen.zh: 昨天，我们以为你真摸到了，大家才那么高兴。
e3_listen.en: Yesterday we thought you'd really touched it. That's why everyone was so happy.

e3_listen.zh: 我知道。我也想让你们高兴。
e3_listen.en: I know. I wanted you to be happy, too.

e3_listen.zh: 而且，都走了这么远，我不太敢说还是没找到。
e3_listen.en: And after coming all this way, I couldn't bring myself to say I still hadn't found it.

options.en: I want to look on my own for a while.
I need to fix what I wrote yesterday.

options.zh: 你可以陪着，但先别告诉我该看见什么。
options.en: You can stay, but don't tell me what I should see.

e3_ch_b.zh: 改吧，昨天是我们太急了。
e3_ch_b.en: Fix it. We rushed you yesterday.

e3_wait.en: I'll sit here and wait for you.

e3_bench.zh: 我今天看见的还是那块空地。
e3_bench.en: All I saw today was the same empty ground.

e3_bench._note: 11-08 作者：透明种子 / 弥洛的纸条从第一章删了，种种子这段跳过（e3_seedless / e3_seed_ask / e3_plant 留着不删）

e3_seed_ask.zh: 广场外有一小块花圃，上午晒得到太阳。
e3_seed_ask.en: There's a little flower bed outside the plaza. Gets the morning sun.

e3_seedless.zh: 能借我几张纸吗？有些话要带回去给弥洛。
e3_seedless.en: Could I borrow a few sheets? There's something I need to take back to Milo.

e3_night.match: 今天，我终于见到了大象

e3_night.zh: 昨天我看见一块空地，伸出去的手也落了空，那时候不好意思说。
e3_night.en: Yesterday I saw empty ground and my hand reached into nothing, and I was too embarrassed to say so.

e3_night.zh: 今天：喷泉这边、另一侧、云台尽头、长椅旁边，都看过。
e3_night.en: Today: this side of the fountain, the other side, the end of the cloud pier, by the bench. Looked at all of it.

e3_night.zh: （画了喷泉的形状）下次换一条路线。
e3_night.en: (a sketch of the fountain) Try a different route next time.
Sure. Can I get salty bread?
I'll save you a crusty end.

epilogue.spec: 【11-07 结局重构：只有芦苇地（真结局）有完整尾声：鹿 → 弥洛 → 泥芙 → 城市 → 列车。回母星直接接列车（epi_home），云层小镇停在小镇。物品状态改变相关动作和局部对白。】

epilogue._note: 11-04 夜测：人在黑幕里先站好，淡入以后不再凭空冒出来

epilogue.zh: 这地图得改改吧？后面要是还有人来，咱可不能再照着带。
epilogue.en: This map needs fixing, doesn't it? If anyone else comes through, I can't go leading them by it.

epi_deer_e1.zh: 见到了。吃草很响，不怎么理人。
epi_deer_e1.en: I did. Loud when it eats. Doesn't pay anyone much mind.

epi_deer_drawing._note: 11-05：新第一关把路标送回空地的支线 flag（原来是旧版的 returned_all）

epi_deer_sign.zh: 你还的那个路标，到现在一直指着云那边。
epi_deer_sign.en: That signpost you gave back still points at the clouds.

epi_deer_rock2.zh: 空地石头上那头，画得也不准。
epi_deer_rock2.en: The one on the rock in the clearing isn't drawn right either.

epi_deer_chat.zh: 下回来，先在路口喊一声，咱听得见。
epi_deer_chat.en: Next time, give a shout at the crossroads. I'll hear.

epi_miluo._note: 11-02 河流篇来客册改成可选：没描杯底记号（river_cup_traced）就不递纸，直接问种子

epi_miluo_cup.zh: 来客册里抄的。你那位朋友到过河流城市，寄过信，可北岸的邮箱被水冲走了。
epi_miluo_cup.en: Copied from the guestbook. Your friend came through the river city and sent letters, but the north-bank mailbox washed away.

epi_miluo_cup.zh: 挑个不会掉进河里的邮箱，很难吗？
epi_miluo_cup.en: Was it that hard to pick a mailbox that wouldn't fall in the river?

epi_miluo_seed._note: 11-08 作者：透明种子从第一章删了，尾声弥洛不再问种子（epi_miluo_planted / _q / _kept / _burned 留着不删）

epi_miluo_planted.zh: 湿土。浇过了，没挖出来看。
epi_miluo_planted.en: Damp. Watered it. Didn't dig it up to check.
Fine. That's all I wanted to ask.

epi_miluo_kept.zh: 那就继续好好放着。别一脸现在就要交作业的样子。
epi_miluo_kept.en: Then keep it safe. And stop looking like you're handing in homework.

epi_miluo_burned.zh: 种子我烧了。燃料不够，我算了好几遍。
epi_miluo_burned.en: I burned the seed. Not enough fuel. I counted again and again.

epi_miluo_burned.zh: 你倒是终于知道，难听的话也得当面说了。
epi_miluo_burned.en: So you've finally learned to say the hard stuff to someone's face.

epi_miluo_burned.zh: 递过来啊，站那儿干吗，光都给你挡住了。
epi_miluo_burned.en: Hand it over, then. Don't just stand there, you're in my light.

epi_miluo_end._note: 11-05：新第一关把收音机送回小吃棚的支线 flag（原来是旧版的 returned_any）

epi_miluo_returned.zh: 那只鹿说，小吃棚的收音机前几天自己响了。八成是风。
epi_miluo_returned.en: The deer says the radio at the snack shed switched itself on the other day. Probably the wind.

epi_miluo_chat.en: Sit if you're sitting. Not that one.

epi_niff._note: 11-04 夜测：人在黑幕里先站好，淡入以后不再凭空冒出来

epi_niff_e1.zh: 找到了。吃草的时候很响，不怎么理人。
epi_niff_e1.en: I found it. Loud when it eats. Doesn't pay anyone much mind.

epi_niff_nofootage.zh: 影像我烧掉了，记不清的地方就空着。
epi_niff_nofootage.en: I burned the footage. Whatever I can't remember, I've left blank.

epi_niff_bell.zh: 你本子第一页这里空着，是忘了吗？
epi_niff_bell.en: The first page of your notebook's blank here. Did you forget?
I don't know this part either.

epi_niff_bell.zh: 那先放着嘛。你哪天知道了，再告诉我呀。
epi_niff_bell.en: Then leave it for now. Tell me when you know.
I'm not big on sweet things.

epi_niff_bell.zh: 啊，拿错啦。这个才是你的。
epi_niff_bell.en: Ah, wrong one. This one's yours.

epi_niff_chat.zh: 这页写着：晨，回来过。这次没写成湿湿的人。
epi_niff_chat.en: This page says: Light, came back. Didn't write you as the soggy one this time.

narr.zh: 第一页：「我一定要找到大象，因为」
narr.en: The first page: "I have to find the elephant, because"

epi_home_end._note: 11-07 作者：结局回看（母星公交车 + 每个支线 NPC 一镜，做了任务是好结果那一版，不能跳），三个去处都放，全剧终卡之前（scripts/ending_montage.gd）

epi_niff_stove.zh: 对了，高处市集那口灶，听说一直没熄过。
epi_niff_stove.en: Oh, right. They say that stove up at the high market has never gone out.

cab_burned_bear.zh: 已经烧掉的：小鹿的玩具熊。
cab_burned_bear.en: Already burned: the deer's teddy bear.

e1_ch_mom.zh: 上一个这么跟它说的，被喷了一身水。
e1_ch_mom.en: The last person who told it that got hosed down.

e1_ch_kid.zh: ……这附近的动物，认亲都挺随便的。
e1_ch_kid.en: ...Animals round here aren't too fussy about family.

e3_pl_b.zh: 那您快叫！它刚把李婶的帽子吃了。
e3_pl_b.en: Then call it, quick! It just ate Auntie Li's hat.

e3_pl_c.zh: 开这种玩笑，我们图什么呀？
e3_pl_c.en: What would we get out of a joke like that?

epi_hi_mom.zh: 妈妈！你不在的时候，咱天天孝敬你，给你的飞机坑浇水。
epi_hi_mom.en: Mama! While you were gone I honored you every day. I watered your crash crater.

epi_hi_child.zh: 孩子，回来啦。外头的路，难走不？
epi_hi_child.en: You're back, kid. Rough out there?

epi_niff_name_p.zh: 晨！要去云层星找大象的晨！
epi_niff_name_p.en: Light! Light who's going to the cloud planet to find the elephant!

epi_niff_name_c.zh: 取件员晨！你的件我还没找到，再等等。
epi_niff_name_c.en: Light the courier! I still haven't found your package. Hang on.
